messages:
maria (Finance): Hey @raj @leo — noticed duplicate 'Platform Fee' line on INV-2026-0421 for AcmeCorp private deployment. Also support tier shows 'Enterprise' but they downgraded to 'Standard' mid-period. Can someone take a look? Invoice shows +$12,000 platform fee twice.

raj (Account Manager): Looking now. Can you paste the invoice lines and contract effective date? pinging @emma for the support-tier change.

maria (Finance): Sure, excerpt below.
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0421
Customer: AcmeCorp (private)
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31
Lines:
 - Platform Fee (Private Deployment) x1: $12,000
 - Platform Fee (Private Deployment) x1: $12,000  <-- duplicate?
 - Support - Enterprise (annual) : $30,000
 - True-up usage: $2,450
Total: $56,450
```

emma (Cloud Ops): We submitted a support plan change to 'Standard' on 2026-03-28; internal ticket #SUP-881. Billing should have applied proration. Maybe auto-bill logic didn't pick up mid-cycle changes.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 generated at 2026-04-03T15:22Z by billing-service v3.4.1

leo (RevOps): If they downgraded before renewal date, Enterprise line shouldn't be full-year. Also duplicate platform fee smells like a migration/legacy fee + platform fee both applied. Can finance confirm GL codes for each line?

maria (Finance): GL codes: 4001 (Platform Fee), 4002 (Support). The duplicate lines both map to 4001.

raj (Account Manager): Assigning to billing queue. @sophia — we need approval to issue a credit note for the duplicate platform fee and to apply prorated support credit. Rough credit: -$12,000 (duplicate) and prorated support credit ~ -$22,500 (Enterprise->Standard mid term) => total credit ~ -$34,500. Thoughts?

sophia (Head of Finance): Approve the credit note. Need memo for audit: reason 'support tier downgrade & duplicate platform fee billing'; attach SUP-881, invoice, and reconciliation spreadsheet. Process through AR with credit memo CM-2026-0457.

leo (RevOps): I'll open AR ticket and attach proof. Also flag for product: billing rules should check for support tier changes within 30 days of renewal. @emma can you create a short postmortem?

emma (Cloud Ops): Yep; opening bug in billing rules: BILL-452. I'll include reproduction steps.

maria (Finance): Thanks all. I'll hold off sending to customer until CM issued. @raj please notify account team once credit posted.

raj (Account Manager): Will do. Notifying AM team and scheduling short customer note once credit applied :thumbsup:
